Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.objects

Class PanelObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.GroupObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.objects.PanelObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
StepObject
public class PanelObject extends GroupObject
Rounded container whose child coordinates start inside its padding. Uses the normal group timeline.

Owns nested scene content while drawing its surface in outer coordinates. Padding translates child origins but does not clip overflow; explicit width/height and child layout remain under author control.
